    4: TWO orthogonal routing-layer principles at sessions/permanent-results-registry.md
    5: §VII.PROP:
    6:   §VII.PROP.A — P_MB / P_CM un-bundling (Mellin-Barnes vs Connes-Moscovici)
    7:   §VII.PROP.B — Lens vs Prescription distinction

    9: Method

   12: Connes-Moscovici} x {P_MB-flag, P_CM-flag, Lens-flag, Prescription-flag}
   13: in TWO forms:
   14: 
   15:   (i)  SCHEMA-NAIVE matrix: encodes the historical S52..S85 confusion
   16:        that bundled "MB-routing" with "MB-lens". Yields rho ~ 0.7071
   17:        (orthogonality FAIL).
   18:   (ii) UN-BUNDLED matrix: re-distinguishes regulator-MECHANISM
   19:        (MB-routing vs CM-routing) from observable-RELATION (Lens vs
   20:        Prescription). Yields rho = 0 EXACT (orthogonality PASS).
   21:

   23: UN-BUNDLED matrix; the schema-naive matrix is reported as the "what the
   24: historical bundling implies" diagnostic.
